relevance_note: This 2017 highlights review gives individual-level detail for one previously published TNFAIP3 carrier: 'By using WES in an infant with lymphadenopathy, splenomegaly and persistent fever, Takagi et al.^37 found a biallelic mutation in the TNFAIP3 (HA20) gene'; all other HA20 patients are mentioned only at group level.
method_note: Read the whole paper manually (no table transcription; none of the tables give individual-level TNFAIP3 data). Scope: one in-scope person, the infant reported by Takagi et al.^37, labelled 'ref 37 patient' under label rule 4 (the review prints the reference as superscript 37, shown as '^37' in the Markdown). Group-level only, so no rows: Zhou et al.^36's 'six unrelated families' and the cohort studies ^38,39, and Table 5's TNFAIP3 row. No variant description is printed, so variant_original_string is 'not reported' per v3. The variant is described only as 'biallelic' and 'predicting a truncated protein'. Neither maps to a single enum value, so zygosity and variant_type_as_stated are 'not reported'. Possible inconsistency: the text says 'biallelic mutation', but the title of reference [37.] reads 'Haploinsufficiency of TNFAIP3 (A20) by germline mutation...'; recorded as printed in the text, without resolving it. 'Persistent fever' was not mapped to the checklist item 'recurrent fever' (persistent is not recurrent), so that item is 'not reported'. 'infant' recorded as age at diagnosis because the WES was done 'in an infant'; onset is not stated. No diagnosis label is given for this person in the text, so disease_label_as_stated is 'not reported'. cites_prior_report_of_same_patients is true because the review attributes the person to Takagi et al.^37. Reference-numbering inconsistency: the text cites 'Zhou et al.^36', but reference [36.] in the list is GuoL et al. (EXTL3); Table 5 cites ^37,38,39 for TNFAIP3 while the text cites ^38,39 for the cohort studies. The study has no patient cohort of its own, so cohort_size_as_stated and n_patients_reported are null.
